fieldValues.title: Retire the remaining 13 subsection records to zero (RFC-042 Change B, srs#710)
fieldValues.summary: Retired the last 13 subsection records under rfc-decision-1e7c0c8e via mechanism/table succession, bringing the subsection count to zero. Found that retyping a subsection to mechanism moves its prose into check-spec-language.mjs's normative scope, a strictly stricter bar than subsections were ever held to, and fixed all 39 resulting violations rather than grandfathering them.
fieldValues.body:
Claimed 2026-09-11T15:1xZ from srs#710's gate:dispatched via srs#580's queue, per the 15:00:43Z re-dispatch (comment 5636405159). Ground: freshly unshallowed worktree matching origin/master (fda4b31); re-measured counts matched the dispatch exactly -- 1 section (Key Invariants) and 13 subsections remained.

The 13 subsections split into 4 sibling groups by contains-parent concept, each carrying its own local precedes chain: Purpose and Scope (4-node chain: What this specification defines -> does not define -> Relationship to implementing systems -> Extension conformance model), Conformance (5-node chain: Core conformance requirements -> Extension conformance requirements -> ext:repository conformance requirements -> ext:repository (self-contained) profile -> Interoperability note), Extension Interactions (2-node pair: ext:protocol x ext:addressability -> ext:lifecycle x ext:addressability), and Extensions (ext:changelog, ext:federation -- no precedes edge between them, none invented). Verified every chain was fully self-contained before touching it: no external predecessor/successor edge on either endpoint survived in any of the four groups, so carried-context-7668a275's splice was never needed this round.

Two subsections (ext:repository (self-contained) profile, Extension conformance model) had already-split example/table children still contains-parented to the old subsection rather than the concept (carried-context-87e8e448): reparented all three (two example leaves, one table leaf) to their concept. Extension conformance model's own content additionally still carried a raw, un-split markdown table (the ext:* dependency matrix) inline -- extracted it into a new table record, distinct from the pre-existing sibling table, and replaced the inline pipes with a one-line pointer sentence in the prose, mirroring the pattern already used for the record's fenced-code-block example.

Checked the ext:* shadow-record fallback (carried-context-4c6e0ddc) for every ext:*-titled record in the batch: the two compound coupling titles ("ext:protocol x ext:addressability", "ext:lifecycle x ext:addressability") do not resolve a bare ext:<name> token at all -- check-rfc-integration.mjs's fallback adds the record's *entire* title string to the extensionIds set, not a substring, so a lookup for exactly "ext:protocol" or "ext:lifecycle" never matches a compound title. ext:changelog already has a dedicated shadow record (extension-86102577.json). No RFC manifest cites ext:federation as a real srs-integration token (two prose mentions found, neither inside a manifest block), so no shadow was needed there either. Grepped every retired title's slug against every RFC's srs-integration manifest for a stale section:/subsection: token (carried-context-c4e43a58): zero hits.

Created all 13 mechanism successors (plus the one extracted table) with meta.derivedFrom set via record update after create, per carried-context-a2429c55 (a derived-from relation does not survive record delete --cascade). Wired contains from each parent concept, recreated the three internal precedes chains among the new successors, and reparented the three orphaned leaves plus the new table to their concept.

Ran part-container-membership.mjs --check and found 3 of 9 Parts drifted (Conformance, Extensions, Reading this specification) -- the record delete --cascade correctly pruned dangling entries from four legacy containerType:"section" containers automatically, but did not add the new successors' ids to the Part containers, which is not auto-synced by relation create (the same gap #758's unit found and filed a carried_context for). Fixed all 3 via srs container members add; part-container-membership.mjs --check then reported all 9 Parts matching.

Ran node scripts/check-spec-language.mjs and hit a new gotcha (filed as a carried_context below): all 13 new mechanism records failed with 39 violations across em-dash-cap, lowercase-2119, soft-hedges, future-tense and facilitate. Traced this to spec-language-registry.json's normativeSites.types listing com.semanticops.spec/mechanism -- the SAME content, unchanged from the subsection it came from, is held to a materially stricter bar the instant its Type becomes mechanism (em-dash cap per paragraph drops from 1 to 0; RFC 2119 keywords must be uppercase rather than merely being permitted; hedge and future-tense patterns start applying). Fixed all 39 in place -- reworded em-dashes to colons, uppercased genuine MUST/MUST NOT statements, removed hedges and future tense, renamed "facilitation" to the concrete mechanism it names ("live conversation tagging") -- rather than grandfathering, matching what every mechanism record created by the prior 7 batches in this series already does cleanly. Two of the fixes (the two ext:* x ext:* coupling records) needed a second pass: moving an em-dash to a colon still left the opening sentence naming every content word of the title (heading-restatement), and two term-definition bullet lists lost their asymmetry when I uppercased every dash to a bold-colon lead-in (bold-lead-in-uniformity) -- both required a small restructure, not just a substitution. Re-seeded scripts/spec-language-allowlist.json afterward (604 -> 563 entries; the extra 35 were pre-existing stale entries unrelated to this batch, cleaned as a side effect of the reseed touching the whole file).

Heading-set diff vs origin/master on both rendered docs: zero lost, zero new -- every one of the 13 retired titles survives verbatim as its successor's title.

node scripts/validate-all.mjs: green, run twice (once before, once after the container-membership fix). node scripts/publish-spec.mjs (pinned build v0.1.0-build.376) re-rendered both docs and its internal check-release-drift.mjs pass (nested validate-all + check-idl-schema-conformance both green). check-gallery-conformance.mjs, check-programme-conformance.mjs and build-governance-seed.mjs --check all green.

Running tally under rfc-decision-1e7c0c8e: #744 7 - #745 6 - #747 2 - #749 5 - #752 9 - #755 5 - #756 11 - #758 7 - this unit/PR #759 13 = 65/75, i.e. ALL subsection records retired (0 remain). Key Invariants (1 section) stays, skipped and reported per carried-context-31ea3659. The closing srs type delete PR is a separate follow-up unit, blocked only on Key Invariants.

PR: https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/pull/759, gate:auto-merge armed (SQUASH). Stopping per the merge-rights contract.
